''Fotballrepublikken'' (The Football Republic) | short name = Brann | founded = {{Start date and age|1908|9|26|df=y}}, as Ski- og Fotboldklubben Brann | ground = [[Brann Stadion]], [[Bergen, Norway|Bergen]] | capacity = {{formatnum:17950}}{{cite web |last1=Brakstad |first1=Thomas |title=– Høsten er full av muligheter |url=https://www.brann.no/nyheter/hosten-er-full-av-muligheter |publisher=SK Brann |access-date=2026-07-21 |language=nb |date=2026-07-21}} | chairman = Arild Mjøs Andersen | chrtitle = Chairman | manager = [[Eirik Horneland]] | league = [[Eliteserien]] | season = [[2025 Eliteserien|2025]] | position = [[Eliteserien]], 4th of 16 | current = {{CURRENTYEAR}} SK Brann season | pattern_la1 = _nikestrike4r25r | pattern_b1 = _nikestrike4r25r | pattern_ra1 = _nikestrike4r25r | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = _brann25a | pattern_b2 = _brann25a | pattern_ra2 = _brann25a | pattern_sh2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | website = {{URL|https://www.brann.no}} }} '''Sportsklubben Brann''' is a Norwegian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Bergen]]. Founded on 26 September 1908, Brann has played in [[Eliteserien|the first tier of Norwegian football]] for 67 out of 80 seasons, the second most of any club. They play their home matches at [[Brann Stadion]]{{cite web|url=http://nifs.no/stadionprofil.php?stadion_id=7012 |title=NIFS – Norsk & Internasjonal Fotballstatistikk |publisher=Nifs.no |access-date=6 September 2008}} where they had a record-breaking average attendance of 17,310 in the [[2007 Tippeligaen|2007 season]],{{cite web|url=http://nifs.no/tilskuertall.php?h2hskjul=1&land=1&t=5&u=2228&visou= |title=NIFS – Norsk & Internasjonal Fotballstatistikk |publisher=Nifs.no |access-date=6 September 2008}} the season in which they won their first league title since 1963. {{TOClimit|limit=3}}"}}
